ko: 넓은 실내: 살짝 높은 눈높이, 앞 가구에서 먼 벽까지 깊이. 캐릭터는 깊이마다 흩어짐, 각 화면 높이 15~25%
prompt: Wide eye-level shot of an interior seen from slightly above, with clear depth from foreground furniture to a far wall; characters are spread through the room at different depths, each about 15-25% of the frame height.

ko: 정면 파사드: 건물 정면이 화면과 평행한 무대 세트. 아래 보도 띠에 캐릭터, 각 20~30%
prompt: Straight-on frontal view with building facades parallel to the frame, like a flat stage set; a sidewalk or ground band runs along the bottom where characters stand or walk, each about 20-30% of the frame height.

ko: 부감: 바로 위에서 내려다봄. 바닥(잔디·마루·천·물)이 화면을 다 채우고 지평선 없음. 각 15~25%
prompt: Bird's-eye view looking straight down; the ground (grass, floor, cloth or water) fills the whole frame with no horizon; characters are seen from above lying or sitting, each about 15-25% of the frame height.

ko: 측면 탈것: 화면 아래쪽을 가로지르는 길·선로·강 위의 탈것(달리든 서 있든)을 정확히 옆에서. 위쪽 절반은 넓은 원경(도시·언덕·바다)
prompt: Side profile view along a road, track or river crossing the lower part of the frame; the main vehicle (car, train, boat or bicycle, moving or stopped) is seen exactly in profile; a wide panoramic backdrop (skyline, hills or sea) fills the upper half.

ko: 가까운 문틀: 캐릭터가 중경에 크게 모임(각 40~55%), 문·창·아치가 액자처럼 두르고 뒤로 자세한 방·거리
prompt: Closer eye-level shot: characters stand together large in the middle ground, each about 40-55% of the frame height, framed by a doorway, window or arch with a detailed room or street behind them.

ko: 야외 전망: 큰 전경 요소(나무·담·난간·천막) 하나가 화면 한쪽을 차지하고, 그 곁에 캐릭터, 반대쪽으로 지평선이 위 3분의 1에 있는 먼 풍경
prompt: Outdoor vista: one large foreground element (tree, wall, railing or tent) fills one side of the frame, characters work or rest near it, and a distant landscape with the horizon in the upper third opens on the other side.
